environment.description: angler 是用于二维光子结构的频域电磁仿真和伴随梯度优化研究库，提供仿真域、材料分布、源与模式、线性/非线性求解、目标函数梯度、结构滤波和优化流程。项目已长期停止发布，适合固定研究样例，不应假定兼容当前依赖。

init_ref_tools.name: Binarizer
init_ref_tools.description: Warning: Experimental Feature!!  Takes a normal objective function and adds a binarization component to it For example:  binarizer = Binarizer(design_region, eps_m)  J = lambda e, e_nl, eps: npa.sum(npa.abs(e)) + npa.sum(npa.abs(e_nl)) J_binarized = binarizer.density(J)  where now J_binarized has multiplied J by some binary dependence on eps defined below in the density method. This can also be done in a fancy way like  binarizer = Binarizer(design_region, eps_m)  @binarizer.density J = lambda e, e_nl, eps: npa.sum(npa.abs(e)) + npa.sum(npa.abs(e_nl))  In this case, J is changed in place with the decorator @binarizer.density

source_metadata.selection_rule: The project has no tags or GitHub Releases. Pin the official repository commit that changes setup.py and angler/__init__.py to 0.0.15; PyPI uploaded 0.0.15 the same release day.

python_source_extraction.selection: public module classes/functions; __init__ and public source-defined class methods (including properties)
python_source_extraction.excluded: private definitions, non-constructor magic methods, imported/inherited APIs, nested definitions, external dependencies; tests/examples outside package directories
